description: Railway-style modulation mode sequencer. Walks a boundary-table mode ladder with hysteresis and minimum dwell; transitions preserve fundamental amplitude/phase (incoming modulator arms phase-locked, switch at the boundary; optional timed crossfade).

inputPorts.name: ModIndex
inputPorts.description: Commanded modulation index (reserved for ceiling-driven boundaries).

inputPorts.name: Allow2
inputPorts.description: Mode-2 availability (pattern engine can arm); false blocks entry into mode 2.

outputPorts.name: ModeFrom
outputPorts.description: Mode being left (during a transition) or current mode (steady).

outputPorts.name: ModeTo
outputPorts.description: Incoming mode (during a transition) or current mode (steady).

outputPorts.name: Blend
outputPorts.description: Output weight of mode 1 in the (0,1) pair (0 = mode 0 duties, 1 = mode 1 duties).

outputPorts.name: Blend2
outputPorts.description: Output weight of mode 2 in the (1,2) pair (routing only; the pattern driver owns the pins when mode 2 is active).

outputPorts.name: TransActive
outputPorts.description: True while a mode transition is in progress.

Allow2.description: Fallback mode-2 availability when the Allow2 input is not wired.

FEnterHz.description: Frequency to enter ladder mode 1 from mode 0 (upshift threshold).

FExitHz.description: Frequency to leave ladder mode 1 back to mode 0 (downshift threshold, below FEnterHz for hysteresis).

FEnter2Hz.description: Frequency to enter ladder mode 2 from mode 1 (upshift threshold).

FExit2Hz.description: Frequency to leave ladder mode 2 back to mode 1 (downshift threshold, below FEnter2Hz for hysteresis).

MinDwellMs.description: Minimum time a boundary condition must hold before switching.

TransMs.description: Transition duration in milliseconds (0 = hard phase-locked switch).

CurMode.description: Persistent current ladder mode state (leave at default).

DwellT.description: Persistent dwell timer state in seconds (leave at default).

TransT.description: Persistent transition-active timer state in seconds (leave at default).
